answer: Bates Media builds custom, mobile-first websites for Juno Beach, FL businesses — designed around conversions, loaded with local SEO, and built to turn local traffic into booked work.
body_html:
Web design for Juno Beach businesses

Juno Beach runs on a mix of locals and visitors — the foot traffic near the Juno Beach Pier and Loggerhead Marinelife Center, the service businesses keeping the oceanfront condos and homes running, the shops along US-1. A lot of those customers are searching on a phone, half a mile from your door. If you don't show up, the next business does.

We build fast, mobile-first sites that capture that local, high-intent search and turn it into a call or a booking.

What's included

  • Custom design — built to your brand, not a template.
  • Mobile-first + fast — engineered for Core Web Vitals and the on-the-go searcher.
  • Local SEO baked in — service-and-city pages, schema, and Google Business Profile alignment for the north county.
  • Lead capture + automation — forms, click-to-call, and follow-up that keeps working after hours.

How we build it

We start with your goals and the action you want visitors to take, design around it, and ship a search-ready site that scales as you add services and nearby cities.

Serving Juno Beach and beyond

We work with businesses across Juno Beach, Jupiter, Tequesta, Palm Beach Gardens, and North Palm Beach — and extend down through Palm Beach County as you grow.

faq.q: Can a website help me reach Juno Beach visitors, not just locals?
faq.a: Yes — strong local SEO plus mobile-first speed means you capture both the residents and the visitors searching nearby on their phones for what you offer.

faq.q: How long does a website take to build?
faq.a: A focused site is usually 2–3 weeks; a larger local-SEO build with multiple service-and-city pages runs 4–6 weeks depending on content and approvals.

faq.q: Will my site rank in Google for Juno Beach searches?
faq.a: That's the goal — dedicated service-and-city pages and proper schema put you in the running for local Juno Beach and Palm Beach County searches.
